g.text: PX MELT CRYSTALLIZER OTS VER 1 - ISSUED FOR TEACHING
P-XYLENE SUSPENSION MELT CRYSTALLIZATION - THREE STAGES WITH MELT RECYCLE
1. Flows in t/h; temperatures in deg C. Numbers are the simulator design point (noise off).
2. Streams 1-13 carry the numbers of the block flow diagram; 14-32 are circulation, melt-loop and filtrate streams inside the blocks.
3. V-102 / V-202 / V-302 are agitated growth vessels; V-401 melts the cakes with a steam coil (E-401, lps).
4. Crystallizer jackets: boiling propylene (C3=) at -3 / -10 / -35 deg C from the K-501 refrigeration package (not shown).
5. Rev 0 issued for teaching. Generated from the simulator model; not a design document.
